verdicts.title: Yet Another Proof of the Joint Convexity of Relative Entropy
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The joint convexity of the map $(X,A) \mapsto X^* A^{-1} X$, an integral representation of operator convex functions, and an observation of Ando are used to obtain a simple proof of both the joint convexity of relative entropy and a trace convexity result of Lieb. The latter was the key ingredient in the original proof of the strong subadditivity of quantum entropy.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The cited paper discusses joint convexity of relative entropy and trace convexity, which are related to operator convex functions. The abstract does not mention anything about order-sensitivity of cumulative entropy or the difference in Φ under different elimination orders.

verdicts.title: Universal Property of Quantum Gravity implied by Uniqueness Theorem of Bekenstein-Hawking Entropy
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: This paper consists of three steps. In the first, we prove that the Bekenstein-Hawking entropy is the unique expression of black hole entropy. Our proof is constructed in the framework of thermodynamics without any statistical discussion.
